thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty P0 triggered 11:30 UTC — kubelet restarting repeatedly on inferpool-usw-2. 3/12 nodes NotReady, elevated 5xx and tail latency on serving runtime.
alyssa_oncall: oncall here, seeing the alert. assigning page and grabbing logs.
raj_runtime: I can jump in — paging from runtime team. any obvious OOMs in kubelet logs?
alyssa_oncall: quick check: `kubectl get nodes -o wide --selector=inference-pool=usw-2`
```
NAME                          STATUS     ROLES    AGE   VERSION
infer-node-12.usw-2.internal   NotReady   <none>   45d   v1.27.4
infer-node-13.usw-2.internal   NotReady   <none>   12d   v1.27.4
infer-node-14.usw-2.internal   Ready      <none>   3d    v1.27.4
...
```
alyssa_oncall: nodes are flapping NotReady -> Ready -> NotReady in ~30s windows.
raj_runtime: pulling kubelet/journal logs now. seeing repeated `kubelet: runtime API error: containerd: container start failed` + GPU resets. dmesg shows repeated GPU resets and then `OOM killer invoked` for `redwood-serving` container.
```
[ 1234.567890] NVRM: GPU at 0000:af:00.0: GPU has fallen off the bus.
[ 1234.568000] nvidia: Xid (Fatal): 79
[ 1234.569000] kernel: Out of memory: Killed process 22456 (redwood-serving) total-vm:183412kB
```
marta_sre: that Xid 79 GPU reset + OOM pattern looks like driver instability causing container crashes which then trigger kubelet to restart pods and eventually kubelet panic on cgroup events.
kai_platform: we saw a slow rolling upgrade of driver package last night in usw-2 image build. possible regression.
alyssa_oncall: immediate mitigations?
raj_runtime: short list: cordon affected nodes, drain non-critical pods, scale up warm spare nodes in other AZs, adjust smart routing to steer traffic away from inferpool-usw-2, and enable fallback to quantized model to reduce GPU mem.
alyssa_oncall: executing cordon now for infer-node-12/13.
```
kubectl cordon infer-node-12.usw-2.internal
kubectl cordon infer-node-13.usw-2.internal
kubectl drain infer-node-12.usw-2.internal --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
```
support-lead: support: customers A and C reported increased latency and timeouts; one customer saw 5% error rate on production calls starting 11:29 UTC. raising status page after we have an ETA.
marta_sre: instead of draining all at once, we should scale the dedicated pool up first to avoid throttling. Kai, can we spin extra instances from reserved capacity?
kai_platform: yes - bumping dedicated pool by +4 nodes in usw-1 and eu-west as warm spares. API call in progress.
raj_runtime: while nodes are cordoned, I'm going to redeploy a runtime config with lower memory footprint variant and enable aggressive KV cache eviction for the pool. patch: `service/runtime: set MAX_GPU_MEM=0.75`
alyssa_oncall: doing a routing rule tweak now to exclude inferpool-usw-2 from low-latency route_policy.
```
POST /admin/routing/policies/steer
{ "pool": "inferpool-usw-2", "weight": 0 }
```
alyssa_oncall: rolling patch applied. traffic should be ~95% diverted within 20s.
raj_runtime: noticed on one node `/var/log/messages` shows `kubelet[1]: fatal error: unexpected signal during runtime execution` right before restart — suggests kubelet process hit a segfault when handling container OOM events. I'm going to capture a journalctl excerpt and open a GDB core capture ticket.
```
Nov 15 11:29:07 infer-node-12 kubelet[1]: fatal error: unexpected signal during runtime execution
Nov 15 11:29:07 infer-node-12 kernel: Tracing trap at 0x7f8c...
```
marta_sre: action items for short-term: 1) keep nodes cordoned/drained, 2) reimage the two NotReady nodes with previous known-good nvidia driver, 3) patch kubelet (backport) if reproducible segfaults, 4) notify customers.
kai_platform: starting reimage jobs now for infer-node-12 and -13 using image `img-2024-11-03-stable-driver`. ETA ~ 12 minutes per node.
support-lead: drafting customer note: "We've detected instability in inference pool in US-W. Traffic has been routed to alternative pools and we are working on remediation. Some customers may experience transient errors. We'll update in 30m." approve?
alyssa_oncall: approve. post to status.redwood.ai/incident/ID-.... include mitigation steps.
raj_runtime: temporary fix applied: runtime scaled down model mem usage and also set autoscaler to add +2 replicas to serving runtime deployment. monitoring shows 5xx rate trending down.
alyssa_oncall: handoff — I need to go offline for scheduled meeting in 10m. Raj, can you take follow-up oncall for the next 2 hours and keep pager open? summarize actions for next oncall: reimage nodes, verify driver stability, confirm kubelet not segfaulting, validate traffic backfill.
raj_runtime: taking it. will keep pager and update every 15m. tagging SRE and Platform.
marta_sre: will create postmortem ticket and link to config change that rolled driver in last build pipeline. assigning to `infra/image-team`.
kai_platform: reimages finishing: infer-node-12 back to Ready at 11:44 UTC after image with older driver. kernel logs no GPU resets. infer-node-13 still reimaging.
support-lead: customer note posted at 11:48 UTC: "Issue mitigated — traffic routed away and problematic nodes reimaged. We are monitoring. If you see persistent errors, please reach out."
raj_runtime: verification: 99.7th latency returned to baseline for critical routes; error rate down to 0.2%. closing P0 page in 30m unless regression.
alyssa_oncall: thanks team. leaving final handoff note in the incident ticket. :thumbsup:
marta_sre: created PM ticket INF-2024-332, assigned owners + timeline. add follow-up to verify we pin driver in image pipeline.
raj_runtime: will follow up with runtime GC tuning and add an automated alert for Xid 79 GPU resets to catch earlier.
incident-bot: PagerDuty resolved at 11:55 UTC by raj_runtime.
alyssa_oncall: marking this thread resolved in slack, will add a short blameless postmortem doc later with timelines and impact numbers.
support-lead: closing customer comms loop once infra confirms all nodes are stable. :white_check_mark:
